memory.query:
SELECT task_id, attempt_id, "cluster", count(*) AS samples,
 min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts,
 max(memory_peak_mb)/1024.0 AS cumulative_host_peak_gib,
 max(memory_mb)/1024.0 AS sampled_host_peak_gib,
 max(cpu_millicores) AS peak_cpu_millicores,
 max(accelerator_mem_bytes) AS reported_accelerator_mem_bytes
FROM "iris.task"
WHERE task_id='/kaiyuew@stanford.edu/ema-gram-20-full-input-capture-v5e-8-20261103/0'
 AND attempt_id=0
 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 08:04:00'
 AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 08:50:00'
GROUP BY task_id, attempt_id, "cluster"
memory.semantics: Observed cumulative task host memory; MiB fields divided by1024. Accelerator memory null; JAX allocator peak is not total HBM.

interpretation: Both unchanged evaluators bitwise match their own untouched references. Both extra-output captures fail fixed1e-5 own-reference gates. Captured intermediate comparisons are instrumentation-only and cannot establish untouched hidden values or full optimizer cause.
limitations: Collection success is not numerical acceptance. Compiler files have size verification only and remain regional; two small Jaxpr files passed SHA256/gzip readback. No warmed performance, profile, checkpoint restoration or trainingMFU claim.
